cards.title: Pendant: Crocodile
cards.extract: This pendant was cast in gold using the lost-wax method. Gold objects are the only Baule art forms associated with ancestor spirits. Pendants can have many uses. Usually hidden in pots or suitcases, gold adornments can be displayed on important occasions such as funerals. They can be laid out around the corpse before burial. A widow will wear them on a chain around her neck or attached to her hair at the ceremony signaling the end of mourning.

cards.title: "Monolithic" concrete house informed by rock-cut monastic homes
cards.extract: Architecture studio Roomoor has completed Monastic Field, a concrete home within a temple precinct in Baleshwar that recalls the rock-cut monk's dwellings of the Deccan Plateau. Set within the site of a Jain temple, the homes was designed for the family that originally donated the land for the temple in 2005. cards.title: 3D printed airless wheels help ground robots bring the wounded to safety
cards.extract: print&live and iSCALE3D have developed arkan, a set of 3D printed airless wheels for unmanned ground vehicles used for casualty evacuation, ammunition transport, and logistical support.
